title: The Long-Term Effects of Cash Assistance
title_zh: 现金援助的长期效应
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We investigate the long-term effects of cash assistance on beneficiaries and their children among participants in the Seattle-Denver Income Maintenance Experiment. Treated families in this randomized experiment received thousands of dollars in extra government benefits for three or five years in the 1970s. We match experimental records to Social Security Administration data using a novel algorithm, finding that treatment decreased adults’ post-experimental annual earnings by $1,800, and increased their disability benefit applications. Effects were strongest around retirement age; evidence suggests possible occupational mechanisms. In contrast, children experienced no significant effects on earnings or interaction with the disability system.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了西雅图-丹佛收入维持实验中现金援助对受益者及其子女的长期影响。在该随机实验中，受助家庭在20世纪70年代额外获得了为期三年或五年的数千美元政府补助。我们采用新型算法将实验记录与社会保障管理局数据进行匹配，发现实验干预使成年受助者在实验后的年收入减少1800美元，并增加了其残疾福利申请。影响在退休年龄前后最为显著；证据表明可能存在职业层面的作用机制。相比之下，子女在收入或与残疾系统的互动方面未受到显著影响。

title: Ecological rationality and the maximum entropy heuristic
title_zh: 生态理性与最大熵启发式
official: 官方在线 2026-07-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This article analyses the notion of Ecological Rationality in the context of decision making under uncertainty. It suggests that constructivist approaches, namely constructivist rationality, are not adapted to solve problems faced in the real ecological environments, which imply large world problems and intractability. The complexity of the decision problems imply search and information costs and thus heuristics, as exhibited by human decision makers might be optimal. It is suggested that inverse S-shaped probability weighting as exhibited by most decision makers might be optimal when facing real world environments. It is shown that the maximum entropy approach can be used to model such kind of behaviour as an approximation to the inverse S-shaped probability weighting. It is argued that this approach is ecologically rational and that such a heuristic can be used to treat financial and econometric decision problems and be a calibrated to decision-makers ambiguity aversion.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了不确定性决策背景下“生态理性”的概念。研究指出，建构主义方法（即建构理性）并不适用于解决真实生态环境中的问题，这类问题涉及“大世界”困境与不可解性。决策问题的复杂性意味着搜索成本与信息成本的存在，因此人类决策者所展现的启发式策略可能具有最优性。研究表明，多数决策者表现出的反S形概率权重在真实环境决策中可能具有最优性。本文论证了最大熵方法可作为反S形概率权重的近似模型来模拟此类行为，并指出该路径具有生态理性特征，可应用于金融与计量经济决策问题，同时能校准决策者的模糊厌恶倾向。

title: Learning by Convex Combination,
title_zh: 凸组合学习
official: 官方在线 2026-07-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study how an agent evaluates an action when she observes a sample of its outcomes rather than its outcome-generating distribution. We propose a model where the agent’s estimated value for the action is a convex combination of her average utility over the sample outcomes and an ex ante utility reflecting her prior information. The weight put on the average utility increases with sample size, reflecting the inferential advantages of larger samples. The model nests certain forms of Bayesian behaviour and, more generally, identifies parameters quantifying departures from Bayesian updating, such as conservatism and the Law of Small Numbers.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究当个体观察到某行动的结果样本而非其结果生成分布时，如何对该行动进行评估。我们提出一个模型，其中个体对该行动的估计值是样本结果平均效用与反映其先验信息的先验效用的凸组合。平均效用的权重随样本量增加而增大，这体现了大样本的推断优势。该模型包含某些贝叶斯行为形式，并更一般地识别出量化偏离贝叶斯更新的参数，例如保守主义和小数定律。

title: Director Appointments, Boardroom Networks, and Firm Environmental Performance
title_zh: 董事任命、董事会网络与企业环境绩效
authors: Mingyuan Chen, Dakshina G. De Silva, Aurelie Slechten
official: 官方在线 2026-06-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Using BoardEx (2000–2017), we create a dynamic network connecting firms and board directors in the United States. We use the Environmental Protection Agency’s Toxics Release Inventory to measure environmental performance at the director and firm-level. We first examine how candidates’ environmental performance and networks affect their probability to be appointed to the board. We find that firms are likely to appoint influential directors with good environmental records and similar characteristics. We then show that directors’ past environmental records affect their current firm’s chemical releases. We address endogeneity concerns related to directors’ appointments and firms’ environmental performance by modeling directors’ network formation.
abstract_zh: 本文利用BoardEx数据库（2000–2017年），构建了一个连接美国企业与董事会成员的动态网络。我们采用美国环境保护署的有毒物质排放清单，从董事与企业两个层面衡量环境绩效。首先，我们考察候选人的环境绩效及其社会网络如何影响其被任命为董事会成员的概率。研究发现，企业倾向于任命具有良好环境记录且特征相似的影响力董事。其次，我们证明董事过往的环境记录会对其当前任职企业的化学品排放量产生影响。通过构建董事网络形成模型，我们解决了董事任命与企业环境绩效相关的内生性问题。

title: Are the Poor More Exposed to Climate Hazards in Latin America?
title_zh: 拉丁美洲的穷人是否更容易遭受气候灾害？
authors: Brunckhorst, Ben James, Doan, Miki Khanh, De la Fuente, Alejandro, Freije-Rodriguez, Samuel, García, Catalina, Nguyen, Minh Cong
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper addresses two main questions. First, what proportion of people are exposed to climate hazards in Latin America and the Caribbean, especially among the poor versus the nonpoor? Second, do certain areas—hotspots—have high rates of bothhazard exposure and poverty that require targeted policy? Using poverty maps and georeferenced climate hazard data, three innovations are introduced: five climate hazards are analyzed (droughts, hurricanes, heatwaves, floods, and landslides); official poverty data at administrative level 2 are used, instead of only administrative level 1; and an interpolation method estimates poverty-plus-exposure rates across countries with varying data sources. The estimates indicate that 36.9 percent of the population is exposed to at least one of the five climate hazards under consideration. Considering the population in poverty only, the percentage is higher, 44.6 percent, whereas the exposure rate for the nonpoor is 34.0 percent. Some areas experience high exposure to climate hazards and high poverty rates. These hotspots include about 10 percent of the region’s population. These areas are in the Brazilian northeast; the upper-Amazon region of Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, and Brazil; the Chaco region of Argentina, Brazil, and Paraguay; the islands of the Caribbean; the western coast of the Gulf of California; and the Yucatan Peninsula.

title: Buying blind? Physical blind boxes in China generally comply with age restrictions and are reasonably transparent
title_zh: 盲目购买？中国实体盲盒普遍遵守年龄限制且透明度合理
authors: Xiaoyao, Ren, Huang, Yuchen, Xiao, Leon Y.
official: 官方在线 2026-05-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Background and Aims: Blind boxes are physical gambling-like products that consumers buy to receive random prizes, often only with a small chance of obtaining a specific product they desire. These products became globally popular in 2025 and are currently not legally regulated as a form of gambling, so children can buy them. Stakeholders are concerned about potential risks, including overspending and gambling-related harm. China is the first and only country to publish dedicated blind box regulatory policy, requiring age restrictions and transparency. Children under 8 are not allowed to buy blind boxes, and minors aged between 8 and 17 must have parental consent for purchasing. The probabilities of obtaining different random prizes must be disclosed. We assessed whether these policies have been duly implemented on the physical packaging of blind boxes manufactured and sold in China. Design: We conveniently purchased a diverse range of 50 blind boxes, including both well-known brands and lesser-known products. We then analysed all information shown on the physical packaging to identify compliance-related elements. Setting: Shenzhen, China Cases: 50 physical blind boxes purchased in November 2025. Measurements: The presence of age restriction information, parental consent requirement, and probability disclosures, and the visual prominence of probability disclosures. Findings: All products (100%) stated that they are not suitable for young children under 8, but 40% failed to also highlight the parental consent requirement for older children aged between 8 and 17. Probabilities were disclosed accurately and completely by 32% of blind boxes, whilst another 48% provided rounded up but still reasonably accurate and complete disclosures, so only 20% failed to disclose sufficiently or at all. The majority (66%) of blind boxes’ disclosed probabilities reasonably visually prominently, but a minority hid relevant information on multiple sides of the packaging (12%) or within a block of descriptive text (8%), making them harder for consumers to find. Conclusions: We observed relatively high compliance with Chinese blind box regulations, in terms of age restrictions and probabilistic transparency, although further improvements are required, particularly in relation to the parental consent requirement for older children and the visual prominence of probability disclosures.
abstract_zh: 背景与目的：盲盒是一种类似赌博的实体产品，消费者购买后随机获得奖品，通常只有极小概率能抽到心仪商品。这类产品于2025年在全球流行，目前尚未被法律界定为赌博形式，因此儿童可以购买。利益相关方担忧其潜在风险，包括过度消费和赌博相关危害。中国是首个也是唯一发布专门盲盒监管政策的国家，要求实施年龄限制和信息透明。8岁以下儿童禁止购买盲盒，8至17岁未成年人购买需经家长同意，且必须公开不同随机奖品的获取概率。本研究评估了这些政策是否在中国制造和销售的盲盒实体包装上得到有效落实。 设计：我们便利购买了50个涵盖知名品牌与冷门产品的多样化盲盒，随后分析实体包装上所有信息以识别合规相关要素。 场景：中国深圳 案例：2025年11月购买的50个实体盲盒。 测量指标：年龄限制信息、家长同意要求、概率披露的呈现情况，以及概率披露的视觉显著性。 发现：所有产品（100%）均标注“不适用于8岁以下幼童”，但40%未同时强调8至17岁儿童需家长同意的要求。32%的盲盒准确完整披露了概率，另有48%提供了四舍五入但依然合理准确的完整披露，仅20%未充分披露或完全未披露。大多数盲盒（66%）的概率披露在视觉上具有合理显著性，但少数产品将相关信息隐藏在包装多个侧面（12%）或描述性文本段落中（8%），增加了消费者查找难度。 结论：在年龄限制和概率透明度方面，中国盲盒法规的合规率相对较高，但仍有改进空间，尤其需强化对较大儿童的家长同意要求及概率披露的视觉显著性。
